Buying Considerations
Connectivity: USB headsets generally provide software-enabled 7.1 surround support, while 3.5mm may have only stereo or simulated surround.
Comfort: Over-ear designs with soft padding are preferable for long gaming sessions.
Compatibility: Ensure the headset works with your PC, PlayStation, Xbox, or mobile if needed.
Audio Features: Look for headsets with 50mm drivers for better bass and spatial awareness in games.
Extras: RGB lighting and inline controls may enhance user experience but are secondary to audio quality.
For purchase, these headsets are available on Amazon India with detailed specifications and pricing .
